subject: Temporary invoice-only onboarding request for Cobalt Analytics (pilot)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cobaltanalytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Cobalt Analytics Finance <billing@cobaltanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looks promising for our anomaly-detection use case. We want to run a 6-week pilot (up to $4,500 estimated spend) starting next week.

Our procurement team has a rigid PO cycle that would delay kickoff by several weeks. For pilots under $5k we typically do invoice-only onboarding. Would Redwood be willing to accept invoices (net 30) for this pilot while we finalize the PO process?

Attached: a one-page SOW and our W9. Happy to sign a short pilot SOW and a basic DPA if needed.

Next steps from our side: provide billing contact and remit info, and sign a pilot SOW.

Thanks,
— Elena Morales
Head of Data Partnerships
Cobalt Analytics
attachments: Cobalt_SOW.pdf (application/pdf), Cobalt_W9.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@cobaltanalytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

Hi Elena — thanks for the SOW and W9. We're excited to partner on the pilot. Quick internal note: for any invoice-only onboarding we require a short risk worksheet and explicit guardrails (spend cap, timeline, and a rollback plan) and Legal needs to confirm DPA coverage.

Logan/Naomi/Karthik — looping you in. Can Procurement/Finance approve a 90-day temporary invoice path limited to $5k for this pilot if the vendor returns the completed risk worksheet and signs the pilot SOW + our standard DPA addendum? If yes, I will confirm with Elena and collect the worksheet.

Elena — I've attached a very small risk worksheet we use to speed approvals (I put our suggested values inline). If you can return that and the signed SOW, we'll prioritize getting Finance sign-off.

Thanks,
Priyom
Growth, Redwood Inference
attachments: Cobalt_Risk_Worksheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 13:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

On Mon, Apr 9, 2028 at 10:03 AM Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Elena — I've attached a very small risk worksheet we use to speed approvals (I put our suggested values inline).

Thanks for the context. Legal is comfortable with a temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots under $5k provided the following are in place:
- Signed pilot SOW that limits scope and data access.
- Execution of our standard DPA addendum (or a vendor DPA that maps to our minimum controls).
- Completion of the risk worksheet with affirmative answers on data classification (no regulated PII), subcontractor use, and breach notification times.

We will not accept indefinite invoice-only status — Finance must set a sunset date (<= 90 days) and a spend cap. Also require the vendor to agree to Redwood's audit and security evidence upon request.

If the vendor checks those boxes I can sign off from Legal.

— Naomi
Director, Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@cobaltanalytics.com>, Cobalt Analytics Finance <billing@cobaltanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

Priyom / Naomi — Finance reviewed the worksheet and the vendor docs. We can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for Cobalt Analytics under these commercial guardrails:
- Cap the pilot at $5,000 total (no single invoice > $2,500 without prior written approval).
- Sunset the invoice-only path after 90 days from the first invoice date; vendor must convert to PO for continued engagement.
- Standard net-30 payment terms.
- Require vendor to submit invoices to billing@redwoodinference.com with the Deal ID in the invoice header.

Please ensure Legal gets the signed DPA and the risk worksheet back; Compliance may request evidence but we don't expect a heavy lift based on the answers. If Naomi confirms DPA and risk worksheet are acceptable, Finance will mark the vendor as approved for temporary invoice-only and I will notify Accounts Payable.

— Logan
Sr. Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@cobaltanalytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Cobalt Analytics Finance <billing@cobaltanalytics.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

Thanks everyone — that path works for us. We've signed the SOW and completed the attached risk worksheet (see the highlighted fields). We will execute Redwood's DPA addendum in DocuSign by EOD. Billing contact: accounts@cobaltanalytics.com.

Attachments: Cobalt_SOW_signed.pdf, Cobalt_Risk_Worksheet_completed.xlsx, Cobalt_W9.pdf

We appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to starting on Thursday.

Best,
Elena
Head of Data Partnerships
Cobalt Analytics
